summary.text: Brian Murray is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 10th Worcester District since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 1 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Murray has served on the Board of Selectmen for the town of Milford, Massachusetts.
He took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on January 4, 2017.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Human Resources and Employee Engagement Committee.
